AfterObtained.rationale: BiiigHug.cs:11-15 selects CardsVar(4) deck cards for removal and calls CardPileCmd.RemoveFromDeck; the sim selects from run.removable_cards() (which run.transformable_cards() also aliases, run.py:406-408, matching C#'s shared IsRemovable / IsTransformable predicate) and removes each from run.deck. Count 4 matches CardsVar(4) (line 9) with no ascension branch.

AfterShuffle.rationale: BiiigHug.cs:17-27 creates a Soot and calls AddGeneratedCardToCombat(soot, PileType.Draw, owner, CardPilePosition.Random). The sim's CardPileCmd.add_to_draw (cmds.py) is documented as that exact call and carries the parity detail the naive port would miss: the random slot is drawn from the SHUFFLE stream (Rng.Shuffle.NextInt(Count+1)), not the shared run rng, and the game's index 0 = top is mapped onto the sim's end-is-top draw pile. Card identity matches (Soot).

guards.rationale: The `player != base.Owner` / `shuffler == base.Owner` / `cardPlay.Card.Owner != base.Owner` family is the multiplayer per-player filter on a hook the game dispatches for every player. The sim is single-player by construction (one RunState, one PlayerCombatState), so the filter is structurally satisfied. Multiplayer-only paths are out of scope under the shared contract.

guards.what: N2: Flash(), CardCmd.Preview(soot, 0.75f), Cmd.Wait(1f) (BiiigHug.cs:23-25) and the Soot hover tip
guards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.Preview are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.

guards.what: N3: AfterShuffle fires per RESHUFFLE, so the Soot count grows without bound over a long combat -- neither side caps it
guards.rationale: Neither codebase guards the hook: C# adds one Soot on every AfterShuffle and the sim's on_shuffle does the same, with no once-per-combat latch on either side. Checked because three other relics in these two batches DO carry a once-per-combat flag and one of them (relic/belt_buckle) is a live gap for never clearing it -- here there is correctly nothing to clear.
